title: Form
subtitle: Form Component: Features and Properties for Effective Form Management in React
description: The Form component acts as a compact wrapper for an HTML form element, effectively handling context management and propagation to its child components. It accepts all standard HTML form properties and additionally offers the following properties:

props.name: children
props.description: Children of the Form element such as Input, Textarea, Labels, Buttons etc.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: This property specifies the function that executes when the form is submitted. It returns a values object containing all field values.

props.name: initialValues
props.description: The initialValues property allows you to specify the default values for the form fields.

props.name: validateOnChange
props.description: Determine whether the form should initiate validation and display errors in real-time while typing.

props.name: validateOnBlur
props.description: Determine whether the form should initiate validation and display errors when a field loses focus.

metaTitle: Advanced React Form with validation, error handling and more
metaDesc: Form component: Optimised extension of the standard HTML form element with additional features for easier form management.
